mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.record_no, r.record_type, r.source_type, r.company_name, r.contact_name, r.contact_phone, r.contact_email, r.agent_id, a.agent_name, r.provider_id, r.owner_id, u.nick_name as owner_name, r.record_status, r.requirement, r.next_follow_time, r.last_follow_time, r.result_summary, r.ext_json, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from biz_business_record r left join biz_agent a on a.agent_id = r.agent_id and a.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into biz_business_record (record_no, record_type, source_type, company_name, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, agent_id, provider_id, owner_id, record_status, requirement, next_follow_time, last_follow_time, result_summary, ext_json, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{recordNo}, #{recordType}, #{sourceType}, #{companyName}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{agentId}, #{providerId}, #{ownerId}, #{recordStatus}, #{requirement}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{lastFollowTime}, #{resultSummary}, #{extJson}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update biz_business_record set del_flag = '2' where record_id in #{recordId}
